en-US.longDescription: LabChart Lightning is the latest iteration of our 34 year history of creating easy to use data acquisition and analysis software. LabChart Lightning empowers innovative researchers to make unique scientific discoveries with unlimited freedom and flexibility. The perfect software for ECG, EMG and EEG data acquisition and analysis, LabChart Lightning is a powerful tool for biosignal recording and both quantitative and qualitative data analysis.
en-US.name: ADInstruments LabChart Lightning

zh-CN.longDescription: LabChart Lightning 是我们经历 34 年的易用数据采集分析软件的研发后的最新力作。它为创新研究者提供无限自由与灵活性，助力实现独特科学发现。作为 ECG（心电图）、EMG（肌电图）和 EEG（脑电图）数据采集分析的理想软件，LabChart Lightning 是生物信号记录及定量定性数据分析的强大工具。
